title_cn: 美国能源部长赖特谈燃料价格、伊朗和委内瑞拉产量
summary: US Energy Secretary Chris Wright says the surge in fuel prices is being driven less by crude itself than by a shortage of refining capacity. Speaking on "Balance of Power: Evening Edition," Wright also says the Trump administration intends to expand US refining capacity and expects gasoline prices to ease in the coming weeks, though he calls diesel a bigger challenge. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Apple Unveils New Products Under Ternus | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 9/9/2026
title_cn: Apple 推出 Ternus 旗下新产品彭博商业周刊日报 9/9/2026
summary: Apple unveiled a new lineup of products Wednesday, including a foldable iPhone, the company's first product launch under its new CEO John Ternus. Bloomberg Intelligence's Mandeep Singh and Bloomberg Tech Host Ed Ludlow discuss the new iPhone Duo and what the announcement says about Ternus' leadership. Then, Economist and Financial Insyght President Peter Atwater, who coined the phrase 'K-Shaped Economy', reacts to Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said it's now a 'C-Shaped' economy. Finally, Michael Conrath, JPMorgan Asset Management Chief Retirement Strategist updates us on what workers in the back half of their careers should be looking at in their portfolios as they prepare for retirement. (Source: Bloomberg)
